What is motion?
questions.a: A body is in motion when its position changes with time relative to its surroundings.

questions.q: Give one example each of straight-line, circular and periodic motion.
questions.a: Car on a road; hands of a clock; a pendulum swing.

questions.q: How do we know a body has moved?
questions.a: By comparing its position at two times with a fixed reference point.

questions.q: What is uniform motion?
questions.a: Covering equal distances in equal intervals of time - a straight, sloping distance-time graph.

questions.q: What is non-uniform motion?
questions.a: Unequal distances in equal times - the body speeds up or slows down.
